P1: 3号道路 is a grassy road that leads east from 深灰市 into the mountains around 4号道路. Many Trainers can be found along the way as they raise their Pokémon for the upcoming cave.
D1:
* Meteorite field, north end of the eastern crater (hidden)
* Meteorite field, southwest crater (hidden)
D2: End of the elevated path south of the larger grass patch
D3: West of the Pokémon Center, on a rock (hidden; requires 碎岩)
P2: The southwest part of the route is occupied by a large crater, where several meteorites embedded themselves in the earth. A recent excavation project has uncovered four of these meteorites, all of which emit a strange energy. Though they are normally unresponsive, if examined while a 代欧奇希斯 is in the party, their energy influences the extraterrestrial Pokémon's capabilities.
P3: Energy from the northwest meteorite balances out the Pokémon's attributes, causing it to change into its Normal Forme.
P4: Energy from the northeast meteorite heightens the Pokémon's offensive capabilities, shifting it into its Attack Forme.
P5: Energy from the southwest meteorite boosts the Pokémon's defensive capabilities, causing it to take on its Defense Forme.
P6: Energy from the southeast meteorite increases the Pokémon's 速度, causing it to change into its Speed Forme.
P7: 月见山 is a mystical mountain that is known for its frequent meteor falls. The shards of stars that fall here are known as 月之石s. Though it was once a large network of tunnels, the cave has since become unstable. Recent collapses have left most areas impassable except for one large chamber that links the two routes. This chamber also provides access to Mt. Moon Square.
D4: Main chamber, on a rock in the northeast corner (hidden)
P8: Upon entering 月见山, you are immediately approached by 劲敌（西尔弗）. He is surprised to see you in Kanto, where he has been training his Pokémon since the previous battle. He admits that you are strong, and cannot help but to challenge you again.
P9: 劲敌（西尔弗） 's team is nearly the same as it was in the previous battle, though his 鬼斯通 and 勇基拉 have since evolved into 耿鬼 and 胡地, respectively. Use super effective moves to target his Pokémon's weaknesses for best results.
P10: After the battle, Silver expresses his frustration that his Pokémon are still too weak to defeat you. Despite their progress, he insists that they still need more training. He decides to take them to the 龙穴, then hurries off.
P11: Mt. Moon Square is a small clearing located on top of the mountain, where few people ever venture. A small shop is located here.
D5: End of the narrow, tree-lined path in the northeast (hidden)
D6: Dropped near the pond by a 皮皮星期一Night
P12: This shop is open from 10:00 am to 5:59 pm, and offers a variety of goods tailored to the weary traveler.
P13: Between 8:00 pm Monday and 4:00 am Tuesday, six 皮皮 appear in the western field. Four of them begin dancing around the pond, which happens to show the moon's reflection, as a kind of ritual to honor the moon. They get startled when you approach and run away, leaving behind a 月之石. The Clefairy repeat their dance every Monday night.
P14: 4号道路 is a one-way road leading downhill from the mountains to 华蓝市.
D7: Northwest hill, north of Picnicker Hope (hidden)
D8: South-central area, dead-end path in the grove of trees (hidden)
D9: Northeast hill, northeast of Picnicker Sharon
